Step.Text: Please Note: - Check that all 4 barriersare free - Using hands Set gimal at center position (0,0). - Do not calibrate in noisy enviroment. - Do not touch or disturb the surrounding area unless instructed to.
MOTOR COMMUTATION - Gimbal should be in belly orientation - System Should Move

ENCODER OFFSET CURRENT VALUE - Gimbal should be in belly orientation - Remove the seal screw using a 4mm Allen driver - Attach the Gimbal Restrictor and insert the screw using a 6mm Allen - System Should Remain Static.
INIT CALIB1 - Gimbal should be in belly orientation - Remove the Gimbal Restrictor completely from gig - Re-insert the seal screw using a 4mm Allen driver. - System Should Preform INIT.
ENCODER OFFSET USE LIMITS - System will preform this step automatically - Gimbal should be in belly orientation - System Should Remain Static.
INIT CALIB2 - System will preform this step automatically - Gimbal should be in belly orientation - System Should Preform INIT.
LONG DRIFT - System will preform this step automatically - Gimbal should be in belly orientation - System Should Remain Static.
CCSF - System will preform this step automatically - Gimbal should be in belly orientation - System Should Move.
ENCODER ECCENTRICITY ELEVATION1 - Gimbal should be in belly orientation - System Should Move In Elevation.
ENCODER ECCENTRICITY AZIMUTH1 - Gimbal should be in nose orientation - System Should Move In Azimuth.
ENCODER ECCENTRICITY ELEVATION2 - Gimbal should be in belly orientation - System Should Move In Elevation.
ENCODER ECCENTRICITY AZIMUTH2 - Gimbal should be in nose orientation - System Should Move In Azimuth.
